facts.fact: Telecom Namibia states that Namibia has two submarine cables landed, WACS (landed February 2011) and Equiano (landed at Swakopmund on 1 July 2022, projected capacity 4 Tbps), both at Swakopmund so not independent stations.

systems.owner: Google; co-landed by Telecom Namibia and Paratus

note: Co-landing of Equiano with Paratus is infrastructure sharing between two landing parties, not a stated sale of capacity to other operators, so no access fact.
